record.rationale: Copies plain and bounded rich text through browser Clipboard APIs with a local plain-text fallback for static browser deployments. The implementation depends on browser or React execution semantics, so no native LibreOffice source file is claimed as its owner.
responsibilities: Copies plain and bounded rich text through browser Clipboard APIs with a local plain-text fallback for static browser deployments.

stackDivergence.rationale: Browser DOM, React, Worker, storage, or lifecycle APIs replace the corresponding native platform boundary.
